New capital funds commercialization and manufacturing expansion, though terms and valuation were not disclosed.
Round co-led by Ferroglobe PLC and Access Industries

Follows $50M DOE grant announced in August
Adds to public-sector support; the grant is prior funding, not part of this financing.
Plans to expand manufacturing and customer programs
Execution and customer adoption will determine whether financing translates into commercial scale.

This is an early-stage commercialization and financing update for a battery technology company, alongside previously announced federal support. Progress on factory scale-up, customer programs and commercial deployment would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
